decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.26 Calibration Readiness CLI for release.
rationale: Visionary: the command creates an honest transition from structural QIF evidence to empirical calibration. Builder: implementation is a read-only composition over four existing package types, is exposed through status and evaluator-packet, and has a fail-closed regression. Guardian: committed examples remain example-only, empiricalCalibrationReady remains false with four exact blockers, package-type mismatch fails closed, and verifier boundaries reject semantic or predictive claims.
recommendation: Release v0.6.26 after final residue scan, commit, push, tag, and GitHub Release.
